body.p: The ocean's spirit devil (?). The hero Bekirdon went off. He said to the daughter and her younger sibling: "Let's go quicker." The father: "This child [is] a devil. Let's go", he said. Now they are going. They(?) went to the lower world. They went [along] a path to the lower world. They gave away the father's crook, here the spits are iron. Whilst the devil child was breathing, it didn't die, the devil child. The ocean's [DCh]: Pn-marking not clear in first clause, why plural?spirit found [it] and killed [it]. The girl he had eaten already long ago. He cleared three paths (?). Eagles [DCh]: Pn-found their children. They don't let them die (?), bring water! The eagles are going. They are going off.marking is confused.[DCh]: Pn-marking is mixed up. The eagles leave(?) them. Those ones come silently to the father's tent now. Eight heroes are coming. They kill all.
